headline: MacKenzie Scott Gives $50M Entirely to Native Students
meta_description: MacKenzie Scott donates $50 million dedicated to Native students, with $10 million for scholarships and $40 million in permanent endowment.
summary_short: MacKenzie Scott commits $50 million entirely to Native students—$10 million for scholarships over five years plus a $40 million permanent endowment.
body:
MacKenzie Scott has committed $50 million exclusively to support Native students, splitting the gift between immediate needs and lasting institutional support.

The donation structures two distinct funding streams: $10 million will directly fund scholarships over the next five years, providing direct aid to students pursuing their educations. The remaining $40 million will be placed into a permanent endowment, creating a self-sustaining financial foundation that will support Native students for generations to come.

This approach reflects a recognition that Native students face unique barriers to higher education. By combining immediate scholarship relief with long-term endowment growth, the gift addresses both pressing current needs and ensures sustained investment in Indigenous educational opportunity.

$10 million for scholarships over five years
All funds dedicated exclusively to Native students
